mission: Self-host official Bandai card images on R2 (owner decision 2026-10-11): additive card_print_image_assets table, verified paced mirror, R2 serving with proxy fallback, image credit. Staging only; no collector release.

impacts.reason: New app/official_images package (not imported by any collector; verified with scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py at base and head: 0 collector runtime files). Additive migration 6c2242f6f439 creates one empty insert-only table. display_image serves the verified R2 copy of the canonical Bandai image when its digest equals artwork_key, otherwise the original URL (proxied by the web app). No identity, price, Market Index or Market Value change; Yuyu-Tei/SNKRDUNK display images unchanged.
Mirror/read-path/health tests; two pinned statement bounds raised by exactly one batched card_print_image_assets read (7 -> 8), still constant in row count.

Image credit in the footer and under the card on print pages (brand.imageCredit). Image resolution unchanged: R2 URLs already pass through, Bandai URLs still use /api/card-image with its exact host allowlist.
Operations doc for the mirror, health check, rollback, r2.dev caveat and the partner-API no-image rule.

resources.name: Staging Postgres: one new empty table card_print_image_assets (migration applied before merge via documented alembic upgrade)
R2 bucket cardpirate-atlas-assets: new content-addressed objects only; existing 42 objects never overwritten or deleted

routes: Public print, catalogue, Market Value, CPI mover and share responses: display_image.url for canonical Bandai images becomes the R2 copy when verified; fallback unchanged
One-time backfill to www.onepiece-cardgame.com: one request at a time, >= 1 s apart, backoff with Retry-After, stop after 5 consecutive transient failures
dependencies: R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL on API and Vercel (already set; used by the 20 existing owned assets)
impact.deployment_impact: API and web redeploy on merge through their normal GitHub triggers. No collector watch path or collector-imported module changes, so no collector build or rollout; collector_services is empty. The migration is additive and applied before this PR leaves draft, so the verifier sees revision 6c2242f6f439.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR: the read path serves every canonical image through the existing proxy again. Rows and R2 objects are insert-only and stay (harmless). Dropping the table would be a separate destructive decision (alembic downgrade f9e5b4a8c012).
recovery.trigger: broken or missing images on sampled public pages; display_image regressions; any 403/429/challenge from Bandai during backfill (run stops itself); verifier failure
recovery.backup: No existing row or object is modified: the migration only creates an empty table, and objects are written only to empty content-addressed keys. Postgres backup not applicable to this change; newest volume backup recorded in the capacity handoff.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt with no collector rollout; then the backfill run summary (mirrored/reused/failed), check_official_images healthy, and sampled pages (home, /cards, /analytics, a /prints page, a share image) loading card art from the R2 origin with a fallback print still loading through /api/card-image.
